page_title: BET 2-0 MAL | Betis v Mallorca 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+2' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
90+1' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' William Carvalho (Betis) is penalised for a foul. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias had a clear view and blows his whistle.
87' Here is a change. Isco is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Nabil Fekir (Betis).
86' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupts the game. One of the players from Mallorca won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
82' Substitution. Vedat Muriqi walks off the pitch and Abdon Prats (Mallorca) comes on as a substitute.
78' Betis control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
75' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. William Carvalho (Betis) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
73' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
72' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 5:1.
69' Here comes a substitution. Chadi Riad is given a rest as he is replaced by William Carvalho (Betis).
69' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Willian Jose and he is replaced by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
69' Here comes a substitution. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Cyle Larin.

65' 2 - 0 Isco produces a sweet pass and picks out Ayoze Perez (Betis) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 2:0!
63' Isco (Betis) hit a long-range free kick towards the roof of the net! The goalkeeper reacts superbly and saves his attempt.
63' Juan Miranda (Betis) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
61' It's time for a substitution. Luiz Henrique (Betis) comes on in place of Assane Diao.
60' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antonio Sanchez.
60' Javier Aguirre decides to make a substitution. Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud will be replaced by Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca).
60' Close! Willian Jose (Betis) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
58' Assane Diao (Betis) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
56' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) jumps into a tackle and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias signals a foul.
55' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
53' Ayoze Perez (Betis) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
51' A cross from Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
49' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle and it's Ayoze Perez (Betis) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
47' Isco (Betis) takes the corner which is cleared.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Javier Aguirre probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Martin Valjent. He is replaced by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
46' Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Isco (Betis) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
45+3' Isco (Betis) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
45+2' Isco (Betis) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Betis.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
42' The current number of corner kicks is 2:1.
37' Isco (Betis) is about to take a corner kick.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Cyle Larin (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Betis earn a free kick.
32' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
29' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
29' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Claudio Bravo rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
26' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
25' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.
21' Willian Jose (Betis) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Betis are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
16' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias had an easy-decision to make.
14' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Mallorca is cautioned for aggressive play.
11' 1:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
7' 1 - 0 Willian Jose (Betis) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
4' A player from Mallorca commits a rough challenge. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
3' Betis hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' German Pezzella (Betis) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Mallorca will kick-off.
